auth_sessions.auth_sessions_email_fkey: FOREIGN KEY (email) REFERENCES auth_users(email) ON DELETE CASCADE
auth_workspace_members.auth_workspace_me: FOREIGN KEY (email) REFERENCES auth_users(email) ON DELETE RESTRICT
FOREIGN KEY (workspace_id) REFERENCES auth_workspaces(workspace_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

auth_schema_migrations_pkey: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX auth_schema_migrations_pkey ON auth_schema_migrations USING btree (migration_id)
auth_sessions_pkey: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX auth_sessions_pkey ON auth_sessions USING btree (session_id)
auth_users_pkey: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX auth_users_pkey ON auth_users USING btree (email)
auth_workspace_members_pkey: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX auth_workspace_members_pkey ON auth_workspace_members USING btree (workspace_id, email)
auth_workspaces_pkey: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX auth_workspaces_pkey ON auth_workspaces USING btree (workspace_id)
auth_workspaces_scope_tenant_id_scope_us: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX auth_workspaces_scope_tenant_id_scope_user_id_scope_workspa_key ON auth_workspaces USING btree (scope_tenant_id, scope_user_id, scope_workspace_id)
idx_auth_sessions_email: CREATE INDEX idx_auth_sessions_email ON auth_sessions USING btree (email, expires_at DESC)
idx_auth_sessions_revoked: CREATE INDEX idx_auth_sessions_revoked ON auth_sessions USING btree (revoked_at, expires_at DESC)
idx_auth_users_role_active: CREATE INDEX idx_auth_users_role_active ON auth_users USING btree (role, is_active)
idx_auth_workspace_members_email_active: CREATE INDEX idx_auth_workspace_members_email_active ON auth_workspace_members USING btree (email, is_active)
idx_auth_workspace_members_workspace_act: CREATE INDEX idx_auth_workspace_members_workspace_active ON auth_workspace_members USING btree (workspace_id, is_active)
uq_auth_sessions_active_email: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_auth_sessions_active_email ON auth_sessions USING btree (email) WHERE (revoked_at IS NULL)
